doc: Stings on the battle presentation's announcements (M3-AUD-18; game/audio/sting_audio.gd, docs/kb/tech/audio_runtime.md 'Battle stings'). events: an EventBus.dialogue_event name -> {sfx: an sfx row; by_arg: {the event's first argument (the encounter id): row}, overriding sfx; duck: a mix.json duck reason held for duck_sec under the sting}. battle_stinger [encounter] fires as the tide line rises before the field -> battle fade; battle_bark [encounter, line_key, speaker_key] with the lead-in line; boss_intro [encounter_id, title_key] as a boss's title card shows (about 3-4 s). reduced: with reduced audio on, a row -> its version without sub-bass.
